channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Trump’s top women officials — Noem, Bondi, Gabbard, Chavez-DeRemer, Leavitt — depart. Controversies and reasons
item.description: The departures have ranged from political disagreements and leadership controversies to investigations and personal reasons. The latest high-profile exit is White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, who is set to leave at the end of August.

item.title: Trump announces Karoline Leavitt will leave White House Press Secretary role
item.description: In a post on Truth Social, Trump described Leavitt as one of his “most trusted aides” and said he understood and respected her decision.

item.title: Tehran signals shift to ‘offensive’ military doctrine, rules out extension of June interim deal
item.description: The standoff comes as Iran signals a tougher military posture and tensions continue around the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz, raising fresh doubts over prospects for a lasting peace.

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on August 13, 2026 : Trump says Iran has ‘No Money’, blasts Tehran over ‘300% INFLATION’ as he touts ‘WALL OF STEEL’ naval blockade in Strait
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on August 13, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Trump says Iran has ‘No Money’, blasts Tehran over ‘300% INFLATION’ as he touts ‘WALL OF STEEL’ naval blockade in Strait
item.description: In a post on his social media platform Truth Social, Trump said the US would likely maintain control of the waterway, describing the ongoing naval blockade as a “wall of steel.”

item.title: DY Chandrachud’s new role: Why did Russia appoint ex-CJI as arbitrator?
item.description: Former CJI DY Chandrachud has been appointed by Russia as an arbitrator in an investment treaty dispute involving Ukraine’s state-owned Oschadbank.

item.title: ‘Lungiwala’ remark row rocks Rajya Sabha: What happened between Sushmita Dev, John Brittas — All you need to know
item.description: A controversy erupted in the Rajya Sabha over BJP MP Sushmita Dev's alleged remark against CPI(M) MP John Brittas. Following a disruption, Dev denied making any disparaging comments, while Brittas alleged she called him 'lungiwala.' The session was adjourned as tensions rose between the two MPs.

item.title: Only 65% get jobs, 6 lakh youth remain unplaced; panel flags rural jobs scheme’s placement gap
item.description: The scheme aims to provide regular monthly wages at or above minimum wages to rural poor youth and has a minimum placement requirement of 70 per cent of those trained, including at least 50 per cent in wage employment.

item.title: Bombay HC asks Vijay Mallya, SBI to ‘move on’ as 2020 asset seizure plea loses relevance
item.description: The court asked the ED to file an affidavit stating whether the settlement process had been completed and whether ‘everything is done and dusted’.

item.title: Kangana Ranaut in legal trouble over ‘gutter’ remark on Gen Z protesters; later clarifies: ‘Cockroach would live in…’
item.description: &nbsp;Kangana Ranaut had criticised the protests held at Jantar Mantar over NEET irregularities and condemned the behaviour and language used by some protesters.

item.title: Air India Phuket-Delhi pilot had sleep issues, was on medication before flight: Report
item.description: Air India’s Phuket-Delhi pilot who tested positive for marijuana told AAIB he had sleep difficulties and was taking medication prescribed by a family doctor.

item.title: Iran had detailed intel on Trump’s Ankara stay, including his floor: Report
item.description: The information emerged as Trump was preparing for the final day of the NATO summit in Turkey on July 8 and contributed to an extraordinary security operation that saw him secretly switch aircraft before leaving the country.

item.title: 42 days after husband’s death, wife comes to know that he is ‘heading home’; Ayushman Bharat declares him ‘recovered’
item.description: In Chhattisgarh's Sarguja district, a dead constable was recorded as alive for 42 days in health records. His widow received an automated message congratulating him on recovery.

item.title: Trump sued over $100,000 Truth Social plan for early access to market-moving posts: ‘Profoundly corrupt’
item.description: Two US media groups have sued President Trump over his company’s plan to charge for early access to his Truth Social posts, claiming it is unconstitutional and corrupt.&nbsp;

item.title: Monsoon damages 143 km of National Highway stretches across 20 states; over 32,000 NH road deaths in 2026
item.description: The southwest monsoon has caused significant damage to stretches of national highways and national expressways across 20 states and Union territories. Over 32,000 NH road fatalities have already been recorded in the first seven months of 2026.

item.title: Mumbai cops bust fake documents racket; four arrested
item.description: The Mumbai Police have busted a racket allegedly involved in making fake Aadhaar cards, birth certificates and educational documents, arresting four persons in two separate cases, an official said on Wednesday.

item.title: Lionel Messi hints at retirement after father’s death, writes open letter, ‘Now, I have serious doubts…’
item.description: Lionel Messi shares an emotional tribute to his late father, Jorge, expressing disbelief over his passing. He reflects on their close relationship, the pain of not having him at the World Cup, and his doubts about continuing his football career without his father by his side.

item.title: Pirro’s special grand jury move raises eyebrows after Trump fury over dropped Reflecting Pool case vandalism charges
item.description: The purpose of the grand jury has not been disclosed, but its formation is raising eyebrows because of its potential to investigate some of the most controversial cases handled by Pirro’s office.

item.title: 'Got firebombed by Indian continent': Trump aide Peter Navarro on his op-ed on New Delhi's Russian oil buy
item.description: Donald Trump's close aide, Peter Navarro, claimed in an op-ed that India's involvement in the Russian oil trade helped sustain Russia's war efforts, an allegation categorically rejected by Delhi. Navarro recalled facing significant online backlash over his op-ed.

item.title: DK Shivakumar-led Karnataka cabinet portfolio allocation: CM keeps Finance, Law among others — who gets what?
item.description: CM Shivakumar expanded his Council of Ministers on 3 August, inducting 19 new Ministers and bringing the cabinet's strength to 33, with one position still vacant. The allocation of portfolios was announced a day before the Monsoon Session of the Karnataka legislature was scheduled to begin.

item.title: Jantar Mantar Season 2: Social media reacts to CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke launching new protests
item.description: CJP plans a nationwide listening tour to gather public feedback, prioritising education from Independence Day. Social media reactions to 'Season 2' of protests have been intense.

item.title: Public capital must catalyse private investment, not substitute it, says FM Sitharaman
item.description: The Centre has used VGF, HAM, InvITs and other measures to reduce risks and improve infrastructure investment prospects

item.title: Who was Zhu Rongji, China’s former premiere and economic reformer who helped power the country’s rise, dies at 97?
item.description: Zhu was closely associated with the reformist economic approach of Deng Xiaoping, widely regarded as the architect of China's post-Mao economic transformation.

item.title: Centre cannot reject extension application on unstated rules, Vedanta tells Delhi HC
item.description: Appealing a single-judge order, the mining major argues the government cannot ignore its 2017 Extension Policy to seek higher revenue from the Cambay Basin block without formally amending the rules.

item.title: Are cigarettes banned in Bengaluru? New tobacco-nicotine law in Karnataka explained
item.description: A Karnataka notification, dated 10 August, bans the manufacture and sale of tobacco and nicotine products. But, are cigarettes banned?

item.title: Quote of the day by N Chandrasekaran on Ratan Tata: ‘Anybody who met Mr Tata came away with…’
item.description: Chandrasekaran's words are a tribute to the late Ratan Tata, reflecting on the personal warmth and national vision that defined the visionary industrialist and philanthropist. Here's why the quote captures a kind of leadership that outlasts a single life.

item.title: Widespread rain expected across northwest and central India as Bay of Bengal system intensifies
item.description: The IMD issues flash flood warnings for parts of Odisha and West Bengal as an intensifying low-pressure system triggers heavy downpours across the Western Himalayas, Delhi-NCR, and central states.

item.title: Solar Eclipse 2026 LIVE Updates: Solar eclipse stuns Europe — crowds in UK, Spain and Iceland left spellbound
item.description: Solar Eclipse 2026 LIVE Updates: Large parts of Spain were plunged into darkness as the Moon moved directly between the Earth and the Sun. In Lodoso, near Burgos. Totality also reached Iceland, with the country's western coast falling into darkness during the afternoon.

item.title: 'Like giving key to robber & not house's owner': Delhi HC asks Meta why scammers access Rights tool, not creators
item.description: Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani directed Meta to place its policy and eligibility requirements for accessing Rights Manager on record. The court also sought an explanation from the company on the grounds used to reject applications from creators seeking access to the content-protection tool.

item.title: ‘Evasive, incomplete, misleading’: What Parliament panel said on Justice Yashwant Varma cash-at-home case
item.description: The panel said a substantial quantity of ₹500 notes was found in the storeroom and that Justice Varma, who resigned in April this year, could not give a satisfactory explanation about the source, ownership or presence of the cash.

item.title: Karnataka bandh August 13: Will Bengaluru schools, banks remain open or closed?
item.description: Bengaluru is unlikely to face disruptions on August 13 as Kannada organisations have called for a Karnataka bandh over the Cauvery water-sharing row.

item.title: SpiceJet Delhi-Pune flight: Over 100 passengers refuse to fly after AC failure leaves cabin hot
item.description: SpiceJet flight SG 105, delayed by two hours, faced a malfunctioning air-conditioning system, leaving passengers in extreme heat. Over 100 refused to continue, leading to protests and medical assistance for some. An alternate aircraft was arranged, and SpiceJet apologised for the inconvenience.

item.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI over governance issues
item.description: In its order, the ministry cited TTFI's failure to conduct elections on time as one of the reasons for the suspension after getting an ‘unsatisfactory response’ to a show cause notice issued earlier.

item.title: 'We're not conscience keepers': Delhi HC rejects Janhvi Kapoor’s plea for blanket ban on ‘obscene’ content featuring her
item.description: The Delhi High Court denied Janhvi Kapoor a broad injunction in her personality rights case, requiring a categorised list of URLs for consideration.&nbsp;

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Grain Terminals at Russia’s Key Black Sea Port
item.description: Three grain terminals in Russia’s Black Sea port of Novorossiysk were damaged in a massive overnight drone attack, as Ukraine escalated strikes on key maritime infrastructure.
